# Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition

> The Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition brings together researchers, academics, legal experts, policy professionals and institutional partners to strengthen international dialogue on AI governance.

- Convened by: Atlas AI Institute
- Website: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/
- Contact: coalition.atlasai@gmail.com
- Member registry: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/members/
- About: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/about/
- Membership: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/membership/
- Research: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/policy-research/
- Publications: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/publications/
- Leadership: https://coalition.atlasai.institute/leadership/founding-committee/
- Citation: Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition. “Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition.” https://coalition.atlasai.institute/

## Focus

The Coalition works on inclusive participation, evidence-informed policy research, human rights and accountability, and institutional capacity and cooperation. Its six research tracks and three initiatives are listed on the Research and Initiatives pages.

## Data boundary

The public member registry contains source-audited profiles. Reported member countries and verified country assignments are distinct measures; no country is inferred for an individual profile without verification.
